name: motionfoundry-monorepo
description: MotionFoundry — Production-ready open-source animated React component library, CLI, and documentation ecosystem.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-registry.mjs && node scripts/build-designs.mjs && node scripts/build-docs.mjs && node packages/ui/scripts/build.mjs && node packages/cli/scripts/build.mjs && pnpm --filter @motionfoundry/docs build
scripts.check: node scripts/build-registry.mjs --check && node scripts/build-designs.mjs --check && node scripts/build-docs.mjs --check && node tests/lint-check.mjs && node tests/typecheck.mjs && node --test tests/motionfoundry.test.mjs
